questions.prompt: Arrange these numbers in order from smallest to largest: 3,412 / 3,142 / 3,421

choices.feedback: 3,142 has 1 hundred while 3,412 has 4 hundreds, so 3,142 is smaller than 3,412.
That lists the numbers from largest to smallest, not smallest to largest.
3,412 is smaller than 3,421 because it has 1 ten and 3,421 has 2 tens.

hints: Compare digit by digit from the thousands place.
3,142 has 1 hundred, 3,412 has 4 hundreds, and 3,421 has 4 hundreds plus 2 tens.

questions.prompt: Which set of numbers is in order from smallest to largest?

choices.feedback: That lists the numbers from largest to smallest.
1,020 is less than 1,200, so it belongs between 1,002 and 1,200.
All of these are 4-digit numbers, so compare the hundreds place after the thousands digit.

hints: Compare the thousands digit first, then the hundreds, then the tens, then the ones.
questions.explanation: 1,002 < 1,020 < 1,200 < 1,202, so only the first set is in ascending order.
